tool_args.rationale: The pilot is confined to H ≤ 0.48, far shorter than the target horizon. A slow-horizon probe is needed to identify the adaptation and test whether the short-window gain persists or reverses.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model from the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation timescale or reliably constrain predictions at H = 20.4.
Additional fine short-horizon observations are less directly informative about the slow-horizon reversal.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon model without sink coupling or periodic Lotka–Volterra model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot and retrieved mechanism notes leave these alternatives insufficiently distinguished; the slow-horizon probe is more informative before choosing a model.
